description: Calculate cross track error (XTE) — the perpendicular distance from a vessel position to the great-circle track between two waypoints — plus side of track (port/starboard) and along-track distances.

lat.description: Latitude as signed decimal degrees (-33.8688), decimal degrees with a hemisphere letter (33.8688° S), degrees and decimal minutes (33° 52.13′ S) or DMS (51° 30′ 26.4″ N). S is negative. Do not combine a sign with a hemisphere letter.

lng.description: Longitude as signed decimal degrees (-4.15), decimal degrees with a hemisphere letter (4.15° W), degrees and decimal minutes (4° 09.0′ W) or DMS (0° 07′ 39″ W). W is negative. Do not combine a sign with a hemisphere letter.

alongTrack.description: Distance from start along the track to the point abeam of the position. Negative when the position is abeam a point behind the start.

beforeStart.description: True when the abeam point falls before the start waypoint.

beyondEnd.description: True when the abeam point falls beyond the end waypoint.

nearestPoint.description: Nearest point on the track (foot of the perpendicular), decimal degrees.

remaining.description: Distance remaining along the track from the abeam point to the end waypoint.

side.description: Side of the track the position lies on, travelling start → end.

xte.description: Cross track error magnitude — perpendicular distance from position to track.
